CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (colored coordinate sets), an organization/presentation (explicit coordinate partitioning), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit colored content sets (referent paths and color attributes) with coordinate values.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (kinds, record times) are separately reported from the color-coordinate content, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: Content is presented as organized coordinate sets (partitioned grid patterns) for the same referent/time.
